title: Lead scoring
description: Models that add points for the profile and the behavior of records and rank them as cold, warm or hot.
help: The primary model of each type shows in the Score field of lists and details. Scores are recalculated on every event, when the model is saved and once a day to apply decay.

empty.title: No scoring models
empty.description: Create a model to prioritize the most engaged records.

dialog.description: Define the criteria that add or remove points and the bands.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.keyHint: Stable identifier used by configuration packages and automations. Generated from the name when left empty.
dialog.primary: Primary model of the type (shown in the Score field)
dialog.bandsHint: Below Warm the score is Cold.
dialog.criteriaHint: Profile adds its points while the record matches the filter. Behavior adds its points on every occurrence, up to the cap, and each occurrence loses its points linearly until zero after the decay days.
dialog.noCriteria: No criteria. Add at least one for the model to score.
dialog.pointsHint: Use negative values to remove points.

errors.invalidKey: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
errors.points: Enter a non-zero integer between -1000 and 1000.
errors.decay: Enter a number of days between 1 and 3650.
errors.bands: Must be greater than the start of the warm band.
errors.filter: Add at least one condition to the filter.

removeDialog.title: Delete scoring model
removeDialog.description: The model {{name}} and every score calculated by it will be removed.

toasts.created: Model created. Scores will be calculated shortly.
toasts.conflict: Someone else changed the model. Close and open it again to edit.
toasts.error: The model could not be saved.

record.empty: No active scoring model for this record type.
